description: Land Title Settle Department - Keppetiwalana, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510201
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their extent, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters.
